flavor_text.one_line: Huaztl — domineering imperial hegemony of the synthesis; law, honor, valor.
flavor_text.one_paragraph: The Huaztl are a warlike imperial hegemony people, a first-order synthesis of Qinzhao and Tollteca [Peer Synthesis / Hegemonic]. They prize law, honor, valor, lean toward the military sphere, and field crossbowmen, heavy_infantry, heavy_cavalry. Outsiders are met as domineering; their patrons touch war.
